description: NaLiGa₂(SiO₃)₄ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.39 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.47 Å. There are two inequivalent Ga sites. In the first Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.12 Å. In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-59°. There is one shorter (1.61 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Li, two Ga, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLiGa₂Si tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ga, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaGa₂Si tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Li and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Li, one Ga, and one Si atom.
